GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   C. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

4. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   C. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   C. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   C. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   B. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   D. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   B. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   D. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

15. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.

16. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Settlement and urbanisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
